// A rational Bezier curve in space: per-point weights (same count as
// ControlPoints) pull the curve toward heavier points
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A9zier_curve).
type RationalBezierCurve3D
    implements ICurve3D, IDeformable3D
{
    ControlPoints: Array<Point3D>;
    Weights: Array<Number>;
}
